sentences.text: Lions are scared of an animal that can't climb, can't hide, and nearly dies every time it drinks.
To drink, a giraffe has to do the splits, so it checks for lions for up to an hour first.
But at nearly six metres tall, it's the best lookout on the savanna.
Zebras even follow giraffes around, just to use them as an alarm.
If a lion gets close, it can sprint at sixty kilometres an hour.
One kick from an adult giraffe can kill a lion.
